description: The one failure table (Phase 15 Failure matrix and Navigation/Refusal overlays). sign_in keys are SignInOutcome kinds the shell renders; overlay keys are what the native machine window shows. Placeholders: {host} {machine} {email} {domain} {code} {count}. direct keys are DirectSignInOutcome kinds the machine window shows after its own password sheet; the machine's own sentence, when there is one, follows as plain text. Every surface reads its own copy and a test pins it to this file, word for word.

declined.message: You chose Cancel on the sign-in page, so this phone wasn't signed in.

interrupted.message: The app was closed while you were signing in, so that sign-in can't finish. Start it again.

verification_failed.message: This copy of the app couldn't prove it owns the sign-in link for {domain}. Install the app from an official channel, or try again later.

rate_limited.message: Too many sign-ins in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

protocol_unsupported.message: This app and {host} don't speak the same protocol version. Update whichever side is older, then try again.

clock_skewed.message: This phone's clock is more than five minutes off from {host}, so the sign-in was refused. Set the clock automatically and try again.

device_key_rejected.message: The sign-in page refused this request ({code}). Update the app.

refused.message: The sign-in page refused this request ({code}). Update the app.

no_browser.message: Install or enable a browser (Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Vanadium…) to sign in.

mismatch.message: That sign-in reply didn't match a sign-in from this phone, so it was ignored.

decrypt_failed.message: The sign-in reply couldn't be decrypted. Update the app and yaran on the machine.

envelope_expired.message: The sign-in reply had already expired. Check that this phone's clock is right, then try again.

offline.message: No connection. Check your network and try again.

tls_error.message: The connection to {host} isn't secure, so the app stopped.

vault_locked.message: Unlock the app to sign in.

secure_storage_failed.message: This phone's secure storage couldn't create or use the sign-in key, or save the sign-in. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart the phone.

keys_unavailable.message: yaran on {machine} can't reach Cloudflare's key service, so signing in again won't help. Try again in a minute.

unavailable.message: yaran on {machine} is temporarily unavailable, so signing in again won't help. Try again in a minute.

host_disconnected.message: {machine} is no longer connected to the cloud. Check yaran cloud status on the machine.

offline.message: {machine} is offline or its tunnel isn't connected

tls_error.message: The connection to {host} isn't secure, so the app stopped.

banner.message: Your session for {machine} ends in 10 minutes

download_refused.message: Downloads aren't supported in the app. Open it in the yaran web UI on your computer.

renderer_crashed.message: The page crashed and was reloaded

session_unreadable.message: The saved sign-in for {machine} can't be read on this phone. Sign in again to replace it.

access_on_direct.message: {machine} is behind Cloudflare Access. Add it through its organization instead.

not_yaran.message: {host} didn't answer as a yaran machine.

redirected.message: {host} answered with a redirect, so the app stopped before sending anything.

direct_offline.message: {machine} didn't answer. Check that it's on and that this phone can reach it.

password_sheet.message: Enter the yaran password for {host}. It goes only to {host}, and the app keeps the sign-in, not the password.

share_ready.message: {count} shared files are ready. Open an agent and choose Attach a file.

share_confirm_single.message: This page takes one file. Attach the first of the {count} shared files here?

share_unsupported.message: This version of iOS can't hand shared files to the page. Update to iOS 18.4 or later.

direct.rate_limited: {host} is refusing sign-ins for a while. Wait, then try again.
direct.no_password: {host} has no password set. Set one on the machine first.
direct.not_yaran: {host} didn't answer as a yaran machine.
direct.access_required: {host} is behind Cloudflare Access. Add it through its organization instead.
direct.upgrade_required: yaran on {host} is too old for the app. Update yaran on that machine, then try again.
direct.redirected: {host} answered with a redirect, so the password wasn't sent.
direct.offline: No connection to {host}. Check your network and try again.
direct.tls_error: The connection to {host} isn't secure, so the app stopped.
direct.vault_locked: Unlock the app to sign in.
direct.secure_storage_failed: This phone's secure storage couldn't save the sign-in. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart the phone.
